purpose: This blueprint defines the source-level adoption contract and does not itself contain vendored production source.

remove_coding: private model reasoning (thought / reasoning_content / thinking_blocks / inline <think>)

source_vendor_seam: agent-server-adapter SSE -> compile-safe no-op/stub seam (real replacement in a later integration layer)
LLM setup gate -> disabled/replaced by Research Adapter config

domain_integration_boundary.research_adapter_layer: Research Adapter + Domain/ViewModel/Command + Xingwen Runtime replacement.
domain_integration_boundary.workspace_integration_layer: Product wiring (conversation-tabs defs -> Research tabs; canvas-ui tool -> Research drive-panel; Artifact Workspace).

reasoning_boundary.reasoning_trace_vs_private: ReasoningTrace is a public derivation record (Evidence-linked, versionable, auditable, explicit, user-safe). It is NOT model chain-of-thought.

excluded_product_surfaces: Private model reasoning surfaces (thought extractor, thought renderer)
hard_rules: Upstream OpenHands file EXISTS -> MUST vendor, never local-rewrite.
Research content replacement via Adapter/ViewModel, NOT second shell.
Visual adjustment = token/font/icon/density/coding-removal, NOT DOM/interaction rebuild.
Component unsuitable -> modify upstream vendored component, NOT parallel local component.
Cannot surgically adapt -> STOP / request architecture ruling. NEVER 'build a second one'.

Private model reasoning (thought / reasoning_content / thinking_blocks / inline <think>) must never cross the product boundary; preserve only disclosure mechanics for explicit public/auditable reasoning.

source_vendor_completion_contract.requirement: At actual source-vendor time, every initial REQUIRED_VENDOR / REQUIRED_TRANSITIVE / PARTIAL_SURGICAL scope entry must receive an explicit disposition.

provenance_contract: provenance.json: disk <-> provenance exact 1:1 equality, plus provenance -> approved source-scope membership, with strict per-entry repository/tag/commit/path/class/hash validation (scripts/check-agent-upstream-adoption.mjs G5). G5 does not assert full source-scope adoption closure.
